description_zh_Hant: Echo 無封面唱片背景。20 款黑白灰 doodle，由內建 imagegen 逐張生成；唱片由 App 原生繪製。
description_en: Twenty monochrome doodle backgrounds for Echo's fallback record artwork, generated individually with built-in imagegen. The app draws the record.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one square background texture for a music app's missing-cover vinyl record. Create an original refined monochrome doodle drawing: loose continuous pen loops, meandering rounded scribbles, tiny curved crosshatches, a few broken wavering lines. Casual human hand-drawn rhythm, restrained editorial graphic finish, not a childish cartoon. Strictly achromatic black and neutral grays, absolutely no hue. Charcoal black paper (#111111), thin medium-dark silver-gray strokes (#444444 to #666666), quiet contrast. A real black vinyl record will be overlaid by app code, occupying the central 83 percent of width: concentrate recognizable varied doodles around the corners and sides while retaining a few quieter strokes through the center. Full-bleed drawing to all four edges, no frame, no padding, no blank border. Flat straight-on 2D background only. No record, no circular hole or reserved circle, no text, letters, digits, logos, watermarks, UI or album mockup. Generate exactly one square image, around 1024 by 1024.
